introduction: Specification 11 implements the streamlined agentkit.Config and New driver loop with prompt prefix caching breakpoints, transcript tool result pruning, batch tool execution, nested tool calling, and termination handling, providing a focused, robust driver for unattended coding pipelines.

glossary.anchored_token_estimation: Context token estimation strategy anchoring to the latest assistant usage report and adding 4 characters per token for subsequent messages.
glossary.cache_breakpoint: Prompt caching annotation (cache_control: {type: ephemeral}) placed on the last block of system, tools, prefix, and rolling user messages.
glossary.context_pruning: Replacing old tool result content in outbound model requests with single-line elision notices without modifying durable transcript messages.
glossary.nested_caller: Context-attached helper that permits tools declaring ReachableTools to execute child tools within their resolved reachable set.
glossary.synthetic_truncation_result: A deterministic notice appended as a ToolResultMessage when an assistant message with tool calls hits the output token cap (StopReasonLength).

requirements.title: Driver Configuration and Constructor Validation
requirements.rationale: A streamlined configuration structure with strict validation ensures deterministic driver instantiation while avoiding legacy configuration sprawl.

criteria.action: define Config with Client, Provider, Model, Effort, System, Prefix, Tools, Policy, Guard, After, MaxTurns, MaxCostUSD, Timeout, Prune, and MaxTokens fields

criteria.condition: both cfg.Client and cfg.Provider are nil
criteria.action: reject construction with an error indicating that an Anthropic client or core provider must be provided

criteria.condition: cfg.Model is empty
criteria.action: reject construction with an error indicating that a model identifier is required

criteria.condition: any tool in cfg.Tools specifies both Handler and Execute, specifies neither, contains reachability cycles, or declares a wrapper reaching a terminating tool
criteria.action: reject construction with an error describing the invalid tool configuration

criteria.condition: cfg contains a valid configuration and tool hierarchy
criteria.action: resolve active tools using cfg.Policy.Resolve(cfg.Tools) and return an initialized Agent instance

criteria.condition: cfg.Provider is provided
criteria.action: prioritize cfg.Provider over cfg.Client for model dispatch

requirements.title: Eager Shell Tool Guard Enforcement
requirements.rationale: Eagerly checking for shell tools across direct and nested tool hierarchies prevents accidental unguarded command execution before runs start.

criteria.condition: any tool resolved from cfg.Tools is a shell tool recognized by guard.IsShellTool and cfg.Guard is nil
criteria.action: reject construction with an error wrapping core.ErrUnguardedExecute naming the tool
criteria.contract: returns nil *Agent and error wrapping core.ErrUnguardedExecute

criteria.condition: any tool transitively reachable through tool wrappers in the resolved tool set is a shell tool recognized by guard.IsShellTool and cfg.Guard is nil
criteria.action: reject construction with an error wrapping core.ErrUnguardedExecute naming the wrapper and reached shell tool
criteria.contract: returns nil *Agent and error wrapping core.ErrUnguardedExecute

criteria.condition: any reachable tool is a shell tool and cfg.Guard is non-nil
criteria.action: accept the configuration and initialize the Agent without returning core.ErrUnguardedExecute

requirements.title: Consumer Execution Surface and Concurrency Control
requirements.rationale: Restricting the public surface to essential execution and inspection methods provides a clean consumer API and eliminates legacy steering and session complexity.

criteria.action: expose its public API consisting solely of Run, Stream, Messages, Usage, and ReachableTools methods

criteria.condition: a caller invokes Run(ctx, prompt)
criteria.action: execute the minimal driver loop to a stop condition, record turns to its transcript, and return a RunResult containing transcript messages, usage, turn count, and stop reason

criteria.condition: a caller invokes Stream(ctx, prompt)
criteria.action: launch the driver loop asynchronously and return an active *core.EventStream that receives execution events without blocking the producer loop

criteria.condition: Run or Stream is invoked while another Run or Stream execution is actively in flight on the same Agent instance
criteria.action: reject the call immediately with core.ErrBusy
for any concurrent invocation of Messages(), Usage(), or ReachableTools() while a run is executing, safely return a consistent view of the respective state without deadlocking or data races

requirements.title: Prompt Assembly and Cache Breakpoints
requirements.rationale: System prompt guidelines and four-point cache breakpoints maximize model prompt cache reuse across turns while keeping system instructions aligned with available tools.

criteria.condition: assembling the system prompt for a model request
criteria.action: combine cfg.System with active tool PromptGuidelines deduplicated in first-seen order using prompt.Build

criteria.condition: constructing outbound messages for a model request
criteria.action: prepend cfg.Prefix messages before the initial user prompt and conversation history
stamp an ephemeral cache control breakpoint on the final content block of the assembled system prompt

criteria.condition: the resolved tool list contains at least one tool
criteria.action: stamp an ephemeral cache control breakpoint on the final tool definition in the tool list

criteria.condition: cfg.Prefix contains one or more messages with content blocks
criteria.action: stamp an ephemeral cache control breakpoint on the final content block of the prefix messages

criteria.condition: outbound user messages are prepared for a request
criteria.action: stamp an ephemeral cache control breakpoint on the final content block of the most recent user message

requirements.title: Outbound Context Pruning and Context Window Bounds
requirements.rationale: Outbound context pruning prevents model context overflows by aging out verbose tool results while preserving complete conversation history on durable transcripts.

criteria.action: define PruneOptions with Threshold float64 and KeepTurns int fields

criteria.condition: cfg.Prune.Threshold is greater than zero before issuing an outbound request
criteria.guard: the ratio of estimated outbound tokens to the model context window retrieved via catalog.Lookup meets or exceeds cfg.Prune.Threshold
criteria.action: replace the body of tool results older than KeepTurns in the outbound view with a single elision notice stating the tool name and original byte length
for any tool result pruned in the outbound view, preserve its ToolUseID pairing with the corresponding assistant ToolUseBlock
for any outbound pruning operation, leave the durable transcript returned by Messages() and RunResult.Messages intact and unmodified

criteria.condition: estimated transcript tokens exceed the model context window capacity retrieved from catalog.Lookup after pruning
criteria.action: terminate the run immediately with RunStopError and return an error identifying the model and context window limit
criteria.contract: RunResult.StopReason is RunStopError and RunResult.Error names the model and context window limit

requirements.title: Turn Continuation and Truncation Notice
requirements.rationale: Decoupling continuation from provider stop reasons and synthesizing fixed truncation notices prevents partial tool execution bugs while allowing models to recover.

criteria.action: determine turn continuation exclusively by evaluating whether the assistant message contains one or more ToolUseBlock elements, independent of StopReason

criteria.condition: an assistant message contains one or more ToolUseBlock elements
criteria.action: skip handler execution for all tool calls in the batch and append a synthetic ToolResultMessage to each call stating that the call was not executed due to output token limits

criteria.condition: synthetic truncation tool results are appended following a StopReasonLength response
criteria.action: continue to the next turn without terminating the run

criteria.condition: an assistant message contains no ToolUseBlock elements and StopReason is StopReasonRefusal
criteria.action: terminate the run with RunStopRefusal and return an error wrapping core.ErrRefusal
criteria.contract: RunResult.StopReason is RunStopRefusal and RunResult.Error wraps core.ErrRefusal

criteria.condition: an assistant message contains no ToolUseBlock elements
criteria.guard: its StopReason is neither an error nor a refusal
criteria.action: complete the run successfully with RunStopEndTurn
criteria.contract: RunResult.StopReason is RunStopEndTurn and RunResult.Error is nil

requirements.title: Batch Tool Execution Pipeline
requirements.rationale: Four-phase batch execution guarantees deterministic guard evaluation, atomic abort decisions, concurrent tool execution without premature sibling cancellation, and ordered results.

criteria.condition: preparing a batch of tool calls in Phase 1
criteria.action: sequentially validate arguments using core.PrepareArguments and evaluate Config.Guard for each call on the loop goroutine, finalizing any blocked call or validation error immediately as an error result without invoking its handler

criteria.condition: evaluating the Phase 2 abort decision before any handler starts
criteria.guard: the run context is cancelled (ctx.Err() != nil)
criteria.action: mark all remaining unfinalized calls as aborted without executing any handlers

criteria.condition: evaluating the Phase 2 abort decision before handlers start
criteria.guard: the run context is active (ctx.Err() == nil)
criteria.action: dispatch all remaining unfinalized calls to Phase 3 execution

criteria.condition: executing tool handlers in Phase 3 without Sequential tools
criteria.action: execute handler functions concurrently with one goroutine per call joined by a sync.WaitGroup without using errgroup

criteria.condition: executing tool handlers in Phase 3
criteria.guard: at least one tool in the batch is marked Sequential
criteria.action: execute handlers sequentially in call order

criteria.condition: finalizing tool execution in Phase 4
criteria.action: evaluate Config.After and emit completion events serialized under a batch-scoped mutex while assigning results by original slot index to preserve assistant call order

requirements.title: Batch Tool Termination Voting
requirements.rationale: Tool-initiated termination allows tools to signal mission completion while ensuring batches always finish executing cleanly and blocked calls do not trigger termination.

criteria.condition: any executed tool handler in a batch returns a result with Terminate set to true
criteria.action: terminate the run with RunStopToolTerminate

criteria.condition: an executed tool votes Terminate true in a parallel batch
criteria.guard: sibling tool calls are concurrently executing in the same batch
criteria.action: await completion of all sibling handlers before terminating the run

criteria.condition: a tool call is blocked by Config.Guard or fails argument validation during Phase 1
criteria.action: record an error result without setting a termination vote
criteria.contract: the blocked call does not trigger RunStopToolTerminate

requirements.title: Nested Tool Execution Pipeline
requirements.rationale: The nested caller pipeline enables tools like Starlark code mode to execute child tools safely with bound reachability, parent attribution, and error introspection.

criteria.condition: executing a tool that declares ReachableTools
criteria.action: attach a core.NestedCaller configured with the tool's resolved reachable set to the handler's execution context

criteria.condition: a nested call attempts to invoke a tool outside the wrapper's resolved reachable set
criteria.action: return an error result indicating that the tool is unreachable

criteria.condition: a nested call is executed through NestedCaller.Call
criteria.action: emit execution events populated with ParentToolUseID matching the parent tool call identifier

criteria.condition: a nested call is blocked by a BeforeToolCall interceptor
criteria.action: return an error ToolResult value with a nil Go error to allow wrapper scripts to process the rejection
criteria.contract: returns ([]core.ToolResult, nil) where the result element has IsError true

criteria.condition: an interceptor votes to terminate during a nested call
criteria.guard: subsequent calls are attempted through the nested caller
criteria.action: reject subsequent calls with core.ErrTerminated and propagate the termination vote to the parent wrapper result

requirements.title: Run Limits, Bounds, and Stream Resilience
requirements.rationale: Strict turn limits, cost bounds, timeouts, panic recovery, and non-blocking streaming ensure unattended agent runs execute within predictable operational boundaries.

criteria.condition: cfg.Timeout is greater than zero
criteria.guard: the run context deadline expires during loop execution
criteria.action: terminate the run with RunStopTimeout

criteria.condition: cfg.MaxTurns is greater than zero
criteria.guard: the completed turn count reaches cfg.MaxTurns
criteria.action: terminate the run with RunStopMaxTurns and core.ErrMaxTurns
criteria.contract: RunResult.StopReason is RunStopMaxTurns and RunResult.Error wraps core.ErrMaxTurns

criteria.condition: cfg.MaxCostUSD is greater than zero
criteria.guard: accumulated model usage cost meets or exceeds cfg.MaxCostUSD before issuing a request
criteria.action: terminate before the request with RunStopBudgetExceeded and core.ErrBudgetExceeded
criteria.contract: RunResult.StopReason is RunStopBudgetExceeded and RunResult.Error wraps core.ErrBudgetExceeded

criteria.condition: the run context is cancelled externally without a timeout expiration
criteria.guard: the loop detects cancellation between turns
criteria.action: terminate the run with RunStopAborted and core.ErrAborted
criteria.contract: RunResult.StopReason is RunStopAborted and RunResult.Error wraps core.ErrAborted

criteria.condition: a tool handler, interceptor, or callback panics during execution
criteria.action: recover the panic, record an error ToolResultMessage describing the panic, and emit an error event without terminating the host process
criteria.contract: tool execution finishes with IsError true and the process remains alive

criteria.action: buffer and drop unread events according to StreamOptions without blocking loop goroutine execution on slow or detached consumers

execution_paths.title: Multi-turn prompt execution with concurrent tool batch

steps.action: invokes agent.Run with a user prompt
assembles the prompt with guidelines and prefix cache breakpoints and sends the request to the provider
returns an assistant message with parallel tool calls
prepares calls sequentially, executes handlers concurrently via sync.WaitGroup, and serializes results into slot order
returns a final assistant message with end turn stop reason
returns a RunResult containing transcript messages, usage, and RunStopEndTurn

execution_paths.title: Outbound context pruning under token threshold pressure

steps.action: configures an agent with PruneOptions and executes a long multi-turn workflow
estimates outbound tokens before request and detects token count exceeding the pruning threshold
replaces old tool result bodies in the outbound view with elision notices while keeping durable transcript messages intact
receives the pruned request and returns the next assistant turn successfully

execution_paths.title: Synthetic truncation recovery on max_tokens response

steps.action: invokes agent.Run with a prompt requiring structured tool execution
returns an assistant message containing tool calls with stop reason max_tokens (StopReasonLength)
bypasses tool handler execution, appends synthetic truncated tool result notices to transcript, and continues to the next turn
receives complete tool call re-issue and returns the final answer
completes the run with RunStopEndTurn

execution_paths.title: Nested tool execution through wrapper tool

steps.action: invokes agent.Run with a prompt triggering a tool with ReachableTools (such as code mode)
attaches a NestedCaller to the tool execution context and launches the wrapper handler
executes a nested tool call through the NestedCaller
validates the target tool against the reachable set, evaluates interceptors, emits nested events, and executes the nested tool
receives the nested result and completes execution returning its parent result
records the parent result in the batch and finishes the run

execution_paths.title: Eager shell tool guard enforcement rejection at construction

steps.action: invokes agentkit.New with a reachable shell tool in Config.Tools and a nil Config.Guard
eagerly inspects resolved and transitively reachable tools for shell tool signatures
rejects configuration immediately returning an error wrapping core.ErrUnguardedExecute naming the shell tool

execution_paths.title: Run termination on budget limit exceeded before request dispatch

steps.action: invokes agent.Run on an agent configured with MaxCostUSD
executes turn and accumulates usage cost from provider responses
checks accumulated cost against MaxCostUSD before issuing the next model request and halts the run
returns RunResult with StopReason RunStopBudgetExceeded and core.ErrBudgetExceeded
